## ⚡ 360 REV — EPISODE #05 BLUEPRINT
### Automatically Save Gmail Attachments to Google Drive & Sheets

**🚀 1. Run This Workflow 24/7 (While Your Laptop is OFF):**
* [Launch Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep05&src=json_sticky&cta=canvas_card)
* *In hPanel, select **Applications → Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n** (Coupon `MMVPS` / Partner Deal auto-applied).*

**📊 2. Copy-Paste Google Sheets Columns (Row 1 Headers):**
`Date_Saved | Sender_Vendor | Clean_File_Name | Archive_Folder | Drive_Status`
* [Open Episode #05 Interactive Setup Hub & 1-Click Sheet Copy](https://360rev-hub.github.io/ep05/?src=json_sticky)

**🎥 3. Watch Video Setup Tutorial:**
* [Watch the 2-Minute Step-by-Step Video on YouTube (@360rev3)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFTTyzGt7GY)

**🛠️ Architecture Highlights:**
* **Zone 1:** Watches Gmail 24/7 for any email containing attachments (`has:attachment`).
* **Zone 2:** Dynamically renames the attachment with `YYYY-MM-DD_Vendor_OriginalName` and computes the `Year/Month` archive path.
* **Zone 3:** Uploads the binary attachment to **Google Drive** (`n8n-nodes-base.googleDrive`) and logs the file index to **Google Sheets**.

## STEP 1: Watch Gmail for Incoming Attachments
1. Double-click **1. Watch Emails With Files (Gmail)** -> connect your Google account.
2. Automatically downloads PDF, XLSX, DOCX, and ZIP attachments 24/7.

## STEP 2: Auto-Rename by Date & Vendor + Upload to Drive
1. **2. Build Clean Date/Vendor Filename** standardizes filenames (`2027-11-02_Stripe_Report.pdf`).
2. **3. Upload Attachment to Google Drive** uploads the real binary file directly into your Google Drive!

## STEP 3: Index File in Google Sheets
1. Double-click **4. Log File Index to Google Sheets** -> select your spreadsheet.
2. Run 24/7 on [Hostinger KVM 1 ($6.49/mo)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep05&src=json_step3)!
